prompt: Redraw one Harpy sprite using the attached image as the exact character and camera-angle reference. Change the joints and wings, not the character scale or camera angle. One character only, completely visible, crisp 2D pixel art on a uniform pure white background. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, frames, floor, shadow, or extra marks.
